en-us.exp_event_erav_house_friends_ongoing: The young masters' friends stay the night, and $names$ is called downstairs to entertain.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_friends_result: Three rounds in, the living-room table is cleared - and what gets spread over the coffee table is $names$.
en-us.event_erav_house_friends_01:
The eldest son leads her, apron on, before his guests like displaying a collectible.
"May I present the family treasure."
Amid the laughter a guest asks her: do the young masters of this house play with you roughly? She has no answer, and earns a fresh round of laughter.
en-us.event_erav_house_friends_02:
The guests use her every which way, swapping out when done.
The apron stays on - "with the apron it feels like the house's property" - nobody is sure which guest said it first.
en-us.event_erav_house_friends_03:
The eldest son watches from the sofa, issuing directions now and then: "Turn around." "Hips up."
The way one drills a house pet in its manners for receiving guests.
en-us.event_erav_house_friends_04:
Past midnight the guests are satisfied and raise their glasses around her.
"To the eldest son's family treasure - kanpai!"
When the rims clink, she is still holding the pose she was told to hold.
en-us.event_erav_house_friends_05:
The guests gone, the eldest son points at the stairs: "Bed. Same as tomorrow morning."
She climbs upstairs clutching her apron. The living-room lights stay on till last - that is this house's old rule.
